Learner Permit
Age Requirements
To apply for a learner permit, you must be at least 15 years of age.
Written Knowledge Test
Required to pass a 50-question closed-book test.  Study this Utah Driver Handbook
, opens in a new tab
.
Validity Period
Written knowledge test scores and permits are valid for 18 months.
